title: ExtractionResult
description: Output of the ai-engine Stage 3 extraction pipeline (ADR-006) returned to core-api. Per-field envelopes carry the model's value, evidence and audited confidence; core-api runs the deterministic checks of RFC-004 section 4 and computes each field's status. Untrusted input: validated again in core before anything is persisted.

contract_version.description: Semver of this schema. Bumped on any contract change; recorded on the persisted extraction.

classification.description: Stage 2 output from the Jev decision model. Label plus per-label calibrated probabilities; thresholds that map probabilities to routing live as versioned code.

label.description: Mirrors app.rfq_kind. OTHER is routed to status IGNORED.

fields.description: One FieldValue envelope per extractable field. All fields optional: a missing key means the extractor found nothing, which core-api records as REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING when the field is required.

origin_text.description: value: raw place text as written (display + audit).

dest_text.description: value: raw place text as written.

quantity.description: value: DecimalString; unit count for FCL equipment or handling units.

cargo_value_amount.description: value: DecimalString; declared cargo value, base of the CIF customs value.

ncm.description: value: 8-digit NCM code (optional field; checked against the NCM reference table).

search_description.description: Canonical service description synthesized for tariff retrieval (embedded for ranking among already-valid rows; filtering is always on codes first — RFC-001 step 3).

embedding_model.description: Pinned embedding model id (qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b in the MVP).

field.description: Field key inside `fields`, when the warning is field-scoped.

message.description: Developer-facing note, never shown to customers unvalidated.

reference_dataset_version.description: Version of the bundled reference dataset (UN/LOCODE, NCM, Incoterms) the extractor normalized against. core-api keeps the same version to avoid drift (RFC-004 section 4).

model_info.description: Pinned model versions for audit and re-evaluation (RFC-004 section 6.3).

prompt_pack_version.description: Version of the extraction prompt pack, when prompts are versioned.

thresholds_version.description: Version of the routing/status thresholds in force.
